note: Reference implementation (reference/miles_diffusion_wan.patch plus reference/miles_diffusion_wan_h100.patch): T from the dump becoming readable to the last Judge-engine publication, median of the per-Judge medians over three H100 NVL Judges pinned to the pair's CPU slice.
